title: Jade Cat Ascension
subtitle: A hungry cat's hot-blooded cultivation story
description: An old jade pendant drops a house cat into a cultivation world. Cultivation, belly and morality together decide what kind of immortal it turns into.

catalog.eyebrow: A third glimmer has woken up
catalog.cardDescription: A house cat touches a jade pendant by accident and lands in a cultivation world. Nothing here can kill you - it only decides how unexpectedly you become an immortal.

states.label: Cultivation
states.description: How much of the world's spirit energy and spellcraft you've grasped

states.label: Belly
states.description: All the spirit fruit and pills eaten along the way

states.label: Morality
states.description: The cat heart you kept whenever temptation showed up

actions.name: Sit down and cultivate
Eat first, ask later
Guard the cat heart

scenes.title: The pendant woke up, and so did the cat
scenes.description: In an afternoon room, an old jade pendant suddenly starts to glow. You reach out one paw to touch it and the whole world flips over - this journey is going to start no matter what.

actions.name: Reach out and touch the pendant
actions.hint: A pawprint of destiny

touch.text: The pendant turns to clear light and sets you down in front of the Jade Sect gate, above a sea of clouds. The path begins here; this step will never change your final standing.

scenes.title: The gate only takes cats with a fate
scenes.description: The elder lets you pick any entry trial. The sword terrace, the pill room and the spirit array all light up at once, and a sweet smell drifts over from the spirit orchard.

actions.name: Swing the little wooden sword
actions.hint: Take the sword terrace head-on

actions.name: Crawl into the pill room
actions.hint: Study the glowing furnace

actions.name: Sit down in the spirit array
actions.hint: Breathe quietly for a full round

actions.name: Sneak off for a spirit fruit
actions.hint: The fruit really does look too sweet

sword.text: The wooden sword is taller than you, but you pounce at its tassel three hundred times and accidentally invent a swift cat style.

alchemy.text: You guard the furnace beautifully and only taste-test one round finished pill. The elder decides to look the other way.

absorb.text: Spirit energy pours up your whiskers into your meridians. You yawn once, and your cultivation takes a solid step up anyway.

steal-fruit.text: The fruit melts the moment it's in your mouth and your belly rounds out at once. The orchard crane writes your name in a little book.

scenes.title: A rogue mouse-swordsman blocks the way
scenes.description: The mouse-swordsman draws his blade and demands your jade pendant. He looks fierce, but his tail has tied itself in a knot from nerves.

actions.name: Meet the mouse blade head-on
actions.hint: Use the cat sword you just learned

actions.name: Offer him a dried fish
actions.hint: Maybe a rogue cultivator is just hungry

actions.name: Pretend a sect elder is behind him
actions.hint: Slip past while he turns

duel.text: You catch the tip of his blade between two paw pads. The mouse is astonished, then concedes that this was a fair match.

share.text: The mouse-swordsman finishes the dried fish, drops the claim on your pendant, and quietly tells you where the secret realm opens.

trick.text: The moment he looks back, you're already far away. Nobody gets hurt, but the move clearly wasn't a bright one.

scenes.title: An unclaimed realm opens under the moon
scenes.description: A spinning gate of light appears in the mountain wall. There might be an immortal's legacy inside - or just three hundred years of lost stairways.

actions.name: Dive straight into the realm
actions.hint: Fortune never waits for cats

actions.name: Wait and go in with your sect
actions.hint: Safer to enter together

actions.name: Sit outside and enjoy the moon
actions.hint: Even cultivators should know their limits

enter.text: You chase a thread of spirit light through three illusions in a row and come out carrying one wisp of pure immortal energy.

escort.text: You look after each other in there. There aren't many treasures, but every cat comes out whole.

leave.text: You don't take the risk. Waiting at the gate, you run into the kitchen disciple bringing midnight snacks. Peace is its own kind of fortune.

scenes.title: An injured senior guards a treasure box
scenes.description: Your senior has collapsed beside the stone steps and asks you to carry the box back to the sect. It's overflowing with spirit light, and there is nobody else nearby.

actions.name: Carry both your senior and the box
actions.hint: Bring them back together

actions.name: Take the box and go alone
actions.hint: Nobody would know what happened here

actions.name: Send up a signal talisman
actions.hint: Stay and keep watch

rescue.text: You drag a senior heavier than yourself all the way up the mountain. The box is intact and your heart is clearer than before.

take.text: The secret art in the box sends your cultivation soaring, but a dark vein quietly surfaces on your pendant. The elder later rescues your senior; nobody dies.

signal.text: The elder arrives quickly. You kept the box and your senior safe, and you took nothing that wasn't yours.

scenes.title: One ten-thousand-year spirit fruit before the tribulation
scenes.description: The fruit can raise your cultivation, or be mashed into three days' worth of fruit paste. Whatever you choose now, the lightning will remember your shape.

actions.name: Refine the whole fruit
actions.hint: Draw the spirit energy into your meridians

actions.name: Eat it all with fish paste
actions.hint: Nobody should face tribulation hungry

actions.name: Share it with an injured friend
actions.hint: Keep only one small slice for yourself

refine.text: The fruit becomes a golden current of spirit energy. Your cultivation reaches the threshold of tribulation, and little sparks run along the tips of your whiskers.

feast.text: You eat until you're perfectly content and roll over, round, at dawn. The spirit energy is all there - most of it just went to your belly.

share-fruit.text: Your friend heals completely and the whole pride stands guard for you. You didn't get the most energy, but you got the steadiest heart.

scenes.title: Nine layers of thundercloud over Jade Cat Peak
scenes.description: The tribulation roars, but it will never hurt you. It only reflects the cultivation, belly and morality you've built up - and hands down the immortal seat that fits you best.

actions.name: Walk into the lightning head-on
actions.hint: Trust the strength you built all the way here

actions.name: Shield your sect with your heart
actions.hint: Block the bolt falling toward the gate

actions.name: Wake the dark vein in the pendant
actions.hint: Swallow the lightning with a shortcut

face-thunder.text: You leap into the light, tail drawing a gold arc. When the thunder fades, the immortal gate opens slowly.

guard-dao.text: You draw the bolt away into the sea of clouds and the whole gate comes through untouched. The wish of every cat holds your path up.

dark-jade.text: The dark vein swallows the thunder. You aren't hurt - but the path you step onto no longer answers to the sect.

endings.title: Immortal King of Ten Thousand Cats
endings.description: Your cultivation runs through heaven and earth, and your heart holds against every temptation. You ascend as king under the eyes of ten thousand cats - and your first decree is: one extra midnight meal at the sect, every day.

endings.title: Free and Wicked Cat Immortal
endings.description: You cut through the tribulation with shortcuts and tricks and became a rogue immortal who comes and goes without a trace. The sect didn't chase you - they just put up a notice at the gate: valuable boxes should be fitted with cat locks.

endings.title: The Chubby Guardian Cat
endings.description: Your belly took the last ray of lightning for you. You never flew very high, but you became the most popular guardian cat in the Jade Sect: your daily duty is watching the spirit orchard and tasting the harvest.

endings.title: Carefree Cat Immortal
endings.description: You walked through the tribulation steadily and became an ordinary, comfortable cat immortal. No need to rule the heavens, no need to hold the great Dao - cloud seas, sunshine and dried fish are already enough.
